mainEntity.name: How long does it take to produce a training lesson with Flipick?

acceptedAnswer.text: A brief or existing deck becomes an approved screenplay and storyboard before any credit is spent, and the finished cinematic lesson typically ships inside a normal project cycle — days to weeks rather than months. Updating a line of content does not require reshooting.

mainEntity.name: How does Flipick prove that learners actually completed the training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every view is tied to a known learner through authenticated delivery. Completion is tracked per lesson and per learner, and Flipick supports in-video assessments so you can tie video delivery to real comprehension outcomes, not just a tick in an LMS.

mainEntity.name: Can Flipick localize one training lesson into multiple languages without re-recording?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Flipick localizes a single production into every language your workforce speaks — same host, same visuals, localized voice and on-screen text. There are no separate shoots or regional versions built later.

mainEntity.name: How does Flipick work with an existing LMS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick delivers training through your current LMS via a secure link or email. For deeper integration, Flipick LMS pairs natively with the AI Video platform, adding adaptive assessments, skills-framework mapping, and completion analytics in a single end-to-end solution.
